connector.name: SocialCrawl
connector.registryDescription: Access 21+ social media platforms through one unified API. Profiles, posts, search.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package socialcrawl-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.

connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
